planning_notes: Board is fixed to arduino:avr:uno; wiring preserved: A0 potentiometer -> analog_input, D6 buzzer -> tone_output.
This proposal only declares IO ports. The mapping from A0 value to tone frequency (including any scaling, clamping, or update policy) is handled in the SysML model.
No serial reporting is required by the provided requirements.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Potentiometer value used to change buzzer frequency

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer tone whose frequency is driven from potentiometer via model
